summary: No public author gene-level result was found for the day-8 hypothalamus comparison of four DSS-treated mice and four controls. Every measurement column in the [ArrayExpress deposit](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/arrayexpress/studies/E-MTAB-15489) contains sample counts. The [closest published study](https://hdl.handle.net/2164/26650) used day-6 DSS samples and shared no BioSamples with the registered cohort. The proposal retains `not_located` and `not_tested`. No ledger was edited.
openIssues: Author effects, P values and FDR remain unassessed. Reopen the comparison if a result table or signed gene list can be linked to the eight registered hypothalamus libraries in PRJEB95986.
